name: Signal 96
introTitle: Welcome to our little corner of the web!
introText:
Signal 96 is a meeting place for people who enjoy science, tinkering and computing. Anyone with the urge to figure things out and share what they find is welcome.

Read our reports, see what we’re building and find the next club meetups. This site grows with our experiments and your contributions.
newsText: Our sky chart helps you find the winter constellations and spot Jupiter with a small telescope.
agendaFirst: Friday, 10 pm: stargazing at the lookout.
archiveText: Mysterious signals, field notes and electronics projects from our members.
focusText: We’re a group of hobbyists who get together to observe, build and share.
contact: Have a question or a discovery? Bring your notebook to the next meetup. Contributions are welcome.
